availability_rule: Every Gate-A row is retained. NO_BET_GATE_A and UNAVAILABLE_CANONICAL_OUTCOME both receive zero realized stake and are never replaced.
chronology_rule: Drawdown and miss streak sort first_kickoff_ts, pool_id, portfolio_id.
scope: historical research only; no purchase, production, or promotion authorization
settlement_rule: Hit iff every canonical result code is in the frozen arm's allowed codes; gross=2*0.65*product(canonical final winning SP) once on hit, else zero; final SP is uncapped.
tax_rule: Each variant/arm is a distinct paper policy. Aggregate its gross by native issue; when issue-policy gross >=10000, apply 20% tax to every winning portfolio gross in that bucket.
